scope: Read-only preparation; no PR011 implementation or dispatch. Actual accepted PR010/PR087 joint dependencies remain unavailable.
observations: classifyResponse already checks MIME, fatal UTF8, HTML/login/challenge indicators, schema/profile and structural/cardinality limits. PR011 should extend these actual ports and preserve metadata-only boundaries.

BoundedHttpClient already classifies status failures, records redacted redirect/failure ledger events and returns typed failures with null capture/body. It currently omits a rich sanitized per-attempt observation result. Its strict metadataFetch records should not receive arbitrary extra fields.

LocalCollector settle stores immutable attempt_outcome for each child with attempt:1; replay requires exact complete/failure/unresolved shape. status/inspect expose per-child outcomes. There is no declared durable latest-attempt/last-good observation API.

The existing durable store and adapter replay must remain the authority; a second journal or an in-memory map would not satisfy persistence. Extending the adapter/replay for bounded attempt evidence may require its exact path in a narrow PR011 ownership amendment before implementation.

Original five PR011 behavior/test paths remain adopted. Do not infer authorization to alter ingestion ownership or released contracts from broad task evidence ownership. Document reachability, payload validation and browser/CORS evidence must remain separate kinds and must not promote actionable recipes from reachability alone.
next_review: Determine the minimum actual public/internal port seam and field model needed for durable attempt evidence, including restart/latest-failure/prior-success/cross-kind invariants, without inventing exports or replacing existing persistence. This is a proposal question, not an approved API.
